name: Goes Around, Cums Around
source:
After graduation, you parted ways with your high school sweetheart. Years later you receive a mysterious phone call from her. She's in pain and has fallen into a dark time. However, she isn't one to give up. She wants to get even with the person who made her in despair, and it involves you and her and a bed. Would you aid her with her plot?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/orborigin]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
毕业后，你与高中时的恋人分道扬镳。多年之后，她突然打来一通神秘电话。她正经历痛苦，陷入人生低谷，却不愿就此认输。她想报复那个让自己绝望的人，而计划涉及你、她，以及一张床。你愿意协助她的谋划吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/orborigin]Patreon[/url]]
